correctness.rationale: The exact factorization C=M D Z^T over integers gives G equivalent to D(Z^T Z)D. For p^a, the unweighted Gram kernel is U_ij=a-max(i,j)+1. Its leading minors and the explicitly derived Schur complement yield the unit-pivot and adjacent-pair alternatives, with p-integral elimination of cross-block entries. Each local output is proved, then lifted via CRT tensor products to all positive n. The boundary n=1, p=2 terminal pair, determinant, modular ranks, and cokernel exponent are handled explicitly. A standalone independent determinantal-divisor computation checked 22,203 minors across 27 moduli; these checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The full finite abelian discriminant/cokernel group of the canonical divisor Ramanujan Gram is a natural unknown integral invariant, not just a convenient reformulation of its determinant. The scanning rule explains nonobvious p-adic pair mergers, determines sharp exponent n^2 or n^2/2, and gives the exact modular collapse p|(a+1). It settles a meaningful all-modulus structural classification, rather than an arbitrary finite numerical cutoff.
